item.title: Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!
item.description:
Arutz Sheva-Israel National News is stopping its round-the-clock news updates at this time in honor of the start of Shabbat and the holiday of Sukkot in North America, where they are being written now.
Updates will resume Sunday night from Israel, following the conclusion of Shabbat and Sukkot at 19:07 Jerusalem time.
Shabbat Shalom and Chag Sameach!

item.title: Russian strikes in Ukraine shut down country’s largest steel plant
item.description:
Ukraine’s largest steel plant has been shut down following Russian strikes after ArcelorMittal announced that it was no longer safe to continue operating the facility.
Meanwhile, five people were killed in Russian strikes on Kyiv, including a 14-year-old Israeli boy. Other areas across the Ukrainian capital were also hit.

item.title: Liberman: Next coalition must be built on values of a Jewish and democratic state
item.description:
Yisrael Beytenu chairman Avigdor Liberman said the next coalition must be based on the principles of a Jewish and democratic state, equal rights and obligations, and “one law" for all citizens.
He said that following “the three most difficult years in the history of the State of Israel," the country must return to the values on which it was founded, which he said were reflected in Theodor Herzl’s "The Jewish State" and in Israel’s Declaration of Independence.

item.title: Zelenskyy: US proposed trilateral meeting with Russia and Ukraine in UAE
item.description:
Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that during his meeting with US President Donald Trump, Washington proposed holding technical-level trilateral talks in the United Arab Emirates involving the US, Ukraine and Russia.
According to Zelenskyy, no date has yet been set for the meeting, and Ukraine is awaiting the US proposal on the matter.

item.title: IDF eliminates Hamas commander who took part in holding October 7 hostages
item.description: Hassan Mahmoud Siam infiltrated Israel during the October 7 massacre and was involved in holding Amit Soussana, Keith and Aviva Siegel, and Dafna Elyakim captive in Gaza.

item.title: Ahead of UN speech, Netanyahu meets Chabad delegation and receives Four Species
item.description:
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu met with a delegation of Chabad rabbis before departing for New York. The delegation presented him with the Four Species and spoke with him ahead of his UN address.
During the meeting, the participants sang “L’chatchila Ariber" with Netanyahu and presented him with the book Oseh Shalom.
Rabbi Yosef Yitzchak Aharonov told Netanyahu: “You are going there carrying a great torch on behalf of the entire Jewish people."

item.title: Senior Iran leader's adviser threatens regional aviation: 'Flights open to everyone - or no one'
item.description:
Mohammad Mokhber, a senior adviser to Iran’s Supreme Leader, threatened Friday to disrupt air traffic across the region amid US sanctions on Iran’s aviation industry.
“If Iran cannot operate flights and receive aviation services at airports, no other country in the region will be able to do so either," he said.

item.title: Daniel Umansky is the 14-year-old Israeli boy killed by a Russian drone strike in Kyiv
item.description:
Daniel Umansky, 14, was the Israeli boy killed Friday morning when a Russian drone struck his family’s home in the Pechersk district of central Kyiv. His mother was injured and evacuated for medical treatment.
The family had previously immigrated to Israel but returned to Ukraine about 20 years ago. Israel’s consul, the Federation of Jewish Communities of Ukraine, and Chabad emissaries are assisting the family.

item.title: Six illegal residents arrested in Nesher area; Daliyat al-Karmel construction site shut for 30 days
item.description: Six illegal residents were arrested in police operations in the Nesher area, including four found at a construction site in Daliyat al-Karmel. The site’s employer was also arrested, and the site was ordered closed for 30 days.

item.title: Messi, Erika Kirk among Israel’s Top 50 Christian Allies for 2026
item.description: Israel Allies Foundation unveils its 2026 list of leading Christian supporters of Israel, with the late Joni Lamb taking the top spot.

item.title: 14-year-old Israeli killed in drone strike on Kyiv residential building
item.description: An Israeli boy was killed in a drone strike on a residential building in the Ukrainian capital. His mother was injured and is hospitalized.

item.title: ‘The crown of our head has fallen’: Rabbi David Batzri laid to rest
item.description: Leading rabbis bid farewell to renowned Kabbalist Rabbi David Shalom Batzri as he is laid to rest, recalling his Torah scholarship, prayer and devotion to G-d.

item.title: IDF reinforces several sectors ahead of Sukkot
item.description:
The IDF is once again reinforcing its forces in several sectors ahead of Sukkot, under the direction of the Chief of Staff, as part of efforts to strengthen security and readiness during the holiday period. Regular battalions and brigade headquarters will remain on standby for rapid deployment until the end of the holidays.
During Sukkot, several combat companies will be assigned to reinforce the sectors, while additional companies will remain in reserve. The forces will remain on alert throughout Chol Hamoed and the second holiday.
Central Command will receive additional reinforcements, including soldiers from the Maglan Unit. Most soldiers at brigade training bases will remain on base during the holiday to maintain operational readiness.

item.title: Special Arutz Sheva interview: Operating at sea - in ways one can only imagine
item.description: Staff Sgt. A., a weapons specialist aboard the INS Rahav submarine, spoke to Arutz Sheva about eagerly awaiting his comrades aboard the INS Drakon and the unique experience of serving at sea.

item.title: IDF launches interceptor at suspicious aerial target in southern Lebanon
item.description:
A short while ago, an interceptor was launched toward a suspicious aerial target identified in the area in which IDF soldiers are operating in southern Lebanon. The details are under review.
No sirens were sounded in the communities in accordance with protocol.

item.title: ‘He always wanted to do more’: Friend remembers reservist killed by IDF drone blast
item.description: Master Sgt. (res.) Ofek Moalem, killed alongside Master Sgt. (res.) Nadav Kali from the explosion of an IDF drone, completed his mandatory military service two years ago and immediately continued serving in the reserves.
